source_audits.source_name: NYC School Construction Authority Projects - School Openings listing/API
source_audits.publisher: New York City School Construction Authority
source_audits.source_type: official project listing and JSON API used by official SCA page
source_audits.coverage_years_checked: SCA API returned School Openings sections for 2013-2025; this clean pack promotes verified 2024-2025 records.
source_audits.update_frequency: Not stated; rows include DateAdded, DateModified, and LastPublished timestamps.
source_audits.geographic_scope: New York City public school capital projects listed by SCA.
source_audits.granularity: Project/listing row with ProjectId, Name, borough/location label, section year, image URL, fact-sheet URL, and publication timestamps.
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Official public SCA webpage/API. No open data license was captured for page or PDF text; use factual metadata with attribution and source URL.
required_caveats: The section year is an opening-list grouping, not a day-level opening date.
Use the linked fact sheet for address, project type, construction start, occupancy, and design-team fields.
Do not infer educational outcomes, access changes, or causal neighborhood effects.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use as the official row-level index for SCA school-opening milestones; preserve ProjectId, FactSheetId, section year, and LastPublished.

source_audits.source_name: NYC SCA School Opening fact-sheet PDFs
source_audits.publisher: New York City School Construction Authority
source_audits.source_type: official project PDF files linked from the SCA Projects page
source_audits.coverage_years_checked: 2024-2025 promoted records in this clean pass.
source_audits.update_frequency: Not stated; files are linked from API rows that expose DateModified and LastPublished timestamps.
source_audits.geographic_scope: New York City public school capital projects.
source_audits.granularity: One project fact sheet with project type, location/address, district, capacity, grades served, construction start, occupancy, architect/engineer, and contractor fields when present.
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Official public PDFs; no open redistribution license was captured. Candidate pack stores factual fields only.
required_caveats: Construction Start is sometimes labelled anticipated in 2024 fact sheets; preserve that qualifier.
Capacity and grades are source descriptors, not outcome or access claims.
PDF address is not a parcel boundary or footprint.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Promote records where address, project type, occupancy, and coordinate source are available; keep full PDF URL and SCA ProjectId/FactSheetId.

source_audits.source_name: NYC Planning Labs Geosearch / NYC PAD address points
source_audits.publisher: NYC Planning Labs / NYC Department of City Planning ecosystem
source_audits.coverage_years_checked: Current address-point lookup at retrieval time; observed results used NYC PAD/Geosearch labels.
source_audits.geographic_scope: New York City address points and place/address search results.
source_audits.granularity: Address point with label, coordinates, source/gid, and optional BBL/BIN addendum.
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Public Geosearch endpoint; attribution URL is embedded in API responses. Verify redistribution terms before production publication of derived coordinates.
required_caveats: Treat as address-point geometry, not a building footprint.
Where the returned label does not exactly match the SCA address, flag the point as approximate and verify before production ingestion.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use for SCA fact-sheet addresses with exact returned labels; keep query URL and returned label.
